display.entryTitle: Tracking Center Second Window Plate Dots Mickey

description: In the Wildlife Tracking Center, look through the second window into the lab. On a laboratory plate inside, dots are laid out as a Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: The Wildlife Tracking Center, the second window
whereToLook.exactSpot: A laboratory plate inside the window. Dots in a Mickey pattern.

bestTip: Press close to the glass and scan the benches rather than the people.

viewing.notes: Lab props are working equipment and get moved.
